**Job Description**

We are on the lookout for a **Senior Data Engineer** to help build the next-generation data foundation for fraud prevention.

Be part of building the financial backbone of Delivery Hero. You’ll develop products that empower millions of customers and merchants, from seamless payments to innovative financial solutions like wallets and credit. Your work will support our path to profitability by creating financial flexibility for users and enabling smooth transactions across our markets.

Our Flink-based streaming platform already powers real-time fraud signals. In this role, you will build and enhance historization capabilities, batch pipelines, data quality framework, and observability tooling to make fraud data reliable, traceable, and easy to use for rule evaluation, model training, inference, and backtesting.

You will work closely with Data Science and Engineering teams and own the full lifecycle of these data solutions, from design and development to operation and continuous improvement.

- Build accurate, point-in-time-correct datasets for model training, backtesting, and analysis.
- Design and build scalable batch pipelines that complement our existing Flink-based streaming platform.
- Develop robust controls for data completeness, freshness, anomaly detection, reconciliation, and business-logic accuracy.
- Build observability capabilities that surface pipeline failures, data drift, and quality issues before they affect downstream models or fraud rules.
- Partner with Data Scientists and Fraud Ops to translate fraud-prevention use cases into scalable, resilient data products while maintaining consistency between batch and real-time processing.

**Qualifications**

**Cloud Data Engineering: experience building production data pipelines using Python, Airflow, dbt, and BigQuery on GCP or AWS.

- **Stream Processing:** hands-on experience with Apache Flink or a similar framework, including event time, state, checkpointing, and late-arriving data.
- **Data Science Enablement: a strong understanding of feature preparation, model training, backtesting, and inference workflows.
- **Data Quality and Observability: experience building validation frameworks, monitoring, alerting, and data lineage for production systems.
- **Engineering Ownership: a track record of owning data solutions from design and implementation through deployment and operations.

Was uns überzeugt:

-
Analytische Kompetenz: Du gehst komplexe Fragestellungen strukturiert an und findest pragmatische, datengetriebene Lösungen. Dabei arbeitest du sicher mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen zusammen und übersetzt Businessanforderungen in technische Konzepte.

-
Daten- & Entwicklungsskills: Du arbeitest sicher mit SQL und relationalen Datenbanken wie Snowflake, nutzt Python, setzt ETL-/ELT Tools ein und hast Erfahrung mit Data Processing Frameworks wie Spark.

-
Cloud & Infrastruktur: Deine Erfahrung mit Services von Cloud-Plattformen (GCP) nutzt du für den Aufbau skalierbarer Datenplattformen und provisionierst sie mit Terraform.

-
Software Engineering: Du bist routiniert im Einsatz von Git, Testing, CI/CD und Containerisierung.

-
Technologieaffinität: Du hältst dich über moderne Data und Cloud-Technologien auf dem Laufenden und setzt neue Impulse bewusst ein.

-
Agile Arbeitsweise: Du bist geübt in agilen Methoden und arbeitest selbstverständlich nach Best Practices und Code Conventions.

-
Kommunikation: Du vermittelst technische Themen adressatengerecht – von Engineer bis Management - und das sicher in Deutsch und Englisch.

Als Data Governance & Platform Engineer bist du die technische Verantwortungsperson für das Data Mesh. Du entwickelst und betreibst die Systeme, die Datenprodukte auffindbar, qualitativ hochwertig, nachvollziehbar hinsichtlich ihrer Herkunft (Data Lineage) und zugriffsgeschützt machen. Darüber hinaus überführst du Governance- und Klassifizierungsrichtlinien von reinen Vorgaben in durchgesetzte, automatisierte Kontrollmechanismen innerhalb der Plattform.
 
**Die Rolle**

- Aufbau und Betrieb des Data-Quality-Frameworks: Automatisierte Data Contracts, Validierungsregeln, Qualitätsprüfungen und Quality Gates in den Pipelines, z. B. Databricks DQ, inklusive Alerting bei Verstößen.
- Implementierung von End-to-End-Lineage und Metadatenautomatisierung über Lakehouse und Katalog hinweg, z. B. Unity Catalog und Microsoft Purview, sodass Lineage automatisch erfasst und nicht manuell gepflegt wird.
- Entwicklung von Zugriffskontrolle und Datenklassifizierung als Code: Fein granulare Zugriffssteuerung in Unity Catalog, Sicherheit auf Zeilen- und Spaltenebene, Maskierung, Tagging und zweckgebundener Zugriff, angebunden an Identitäten, z. B. Entra ID.
- Automatisierung des Lebenszyklus von Datenprodukten: Templates, CI/CD für Datenprodukte, Katalogregistrierung sowie technische Prüfungen, die ein Produkt vor der Veröffentlichung als compliant zertifizieren.
- Technische Implementierung von Klassifizierungs- und Sharing-Regeln, intern standardmäßig offen, mit Maskierung bzw. Einschränkung für vertraglich geschützte und personenbezogene Daten, in Zusammenarbeit mit Cyber Security und Datenschutz.
- Instrumentierung von Nutzungs- und Qualitätstelemetrie, z. B. Nutzung, Aktualität und Qualitätsbewertungen, damit Teilbarkeit und das Wiederverwendungs-/Credit-Modell auf realen Daten basieren.
- Unterstützung von Domain-Teams mit Tooling und Referenzimplementierungen, damit sie schnell compliant Datenprodukte bereitstellen können.
 
**Dein Profil**

- Hochschulabschluss oder gleichwertige Qualifikation in Informatik, Computer Engineering, Informationstechnologie oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet.
- Praktische Erfahrung im Design und in der Implementierung von Datenpipelines sowie Data-Mesh-Architekturen in regulierten, dezentralen Unternehmensumgebungen.
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse im Data Engineering: Python und fortgeschrittenes SQL, Spark, Pipeline- und Orchestrierungswerkzeuge, z. B. Airflow, dbt oder vergleichbar, CI/CD und Infrastructure as Code.
- Umfassende Kenntnisse in Databricks und Unity Catalog: Governance-Funktionen, Zugriffskontrolle, Lineage, Tagging; zusätzlich Microsoft Purview oder ein vergleichbarer Katalog-/Lineage-Stack.
- Expertise im Bereich Data-Quality Engineering, insbesondere Data Contracts, Validierungsframeworks und Observability.
- Know-how in Zugriffskontrolle und Security Engineering: RBAC/ABAC, Sicherheit auf Zeilen- und Spaltenebene, Maskierung, Verschlüsselung und Schlüsselverwaltung sowie Identitätsintegration, z. B. Entra ID.
- Praktische Kenntnisse zu DSGVO, Datenklassifizierung und KRITIS sowie deren Übersetzung in technische Kontrollen im Sinne eines Policy-as-Code-Ansatzes.
- Ausreichendes Architekturverständnis, um eng mit dem Data Architect zusammenzuarbeiten sowie eine pragmatische und umsetzungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.

Du zählst für uns!

Dafür suchen wir eine\*n **Computer Vision & 3D/BIM Data Engineer (m/w/d)**, der/die an der Schnittstelle von **Computer Vision, 3D-Geometrie, BIM und Machine Learning** arbeitet.

## Deine Aufgaben

- Entwicklung von **geometry-aware Datenpipelines** für architektonische 2D-, 3D- und BIM-Daten
- Verarbeitung und Strukturierung von **BIM-/3D-Modellen**, insbesondere Meshes, Punktwolken und IFC-Daten
- Überführung von 3D- und BIM-Daten in **maschinenlesbare Repräsentationen** für KI-Modelle
- Entwicklung von Verfahren zur Erzeugung und Verarbeitung von:
    - semantischen Segmentierungen
    - Region Masks
    - Material IDs
    - Depth Maps
    - Normal Maps
    - weiteren geometriebezogenen Features
- Verknüpfung von **2D-Renderings mit korrespondierenden 3D-/BIM-Geometrien**

- Aufbau von Datenpipelines für die Erstellung synthetischer Trainings- und Evaluationsdaten
- Vorbereitung, Normalisierung, Versionierung und Qualitätsprüfung großer Trainingsdatensätze

You will be a Data Engineer supporting the Process Digitalization Team for Grid Technologies within our Siemens Energy organization. As a successful candidate you will demonstrate the ability to proactively drive complex, cross-functional and strategic data & analytics initiatives with passion that impacts our future competitiveness and product portfolio on the market.

 

 

How You’ll Make an Impact
     * Design, rollout and maintenance of the Factory Data Cloud (Data Mesh) with strong focus on data ingestions from different sources
     * Comprehensive analysis regarding data and processes to define respectively align data structures (data unification) and data products
     * Specific and hands-on implementation support regarding data cloud architectures and data ingestions
     * Continuous optimization of data, value and process chains within the Business Area to become a data-driven, transparent, agile and efficient organization

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

ABOUT TRADEBYTE

At Tradebyte, we work with the biggest players in e-commerce - from trendsetting fashion brands to major online retailers. Our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and empowered.
We offer flexible work schedules, professional development opportunities, and a real commitment to work-life balance. We embrace diverse perspectives and ensure that every voice is heard and respected, because you’re unique and that matters to us.
As we continue to grow, we’re looking for new colleagues who share our passion. Love what you do - do what you love. Join Tradebyte, an independent company within the Zalando Group!

THE ROLE AND THE TEAM
This role is centered on building a Centralized Data Lakehouse from scratch. The team's mission is to elevate "Data as Exhaust" into "Data as a 1st Class Citizen," focusing on reliable and repeatable insights through high data quality, robust Medallion architectures, and sustainable designs. Key factors for the 2026 strategy include a "Product Mindset" towards data and intense collaboration and knowledge-sharing with the Zalando Data Foundation.

WHAT WE’D LOVE YOU TO DO (AND LOVE DOING) 
You will take end-to-end responsibility for our Data Refinery – from ingestion (CDC) to providing business-ready data products in the Gold layer.

You will design, build, and maintain scalable ELT pipelines using Databricks Delta Live Tables (DLT).

You will liaise with the owners of source systems (e.g., TB.One) to define and align Data Contracts.

You will implement and oversee Data Governance and security standards within the Unity Catalog.

You will perform technical analysis and root cause analysis to improve data quality and pipeline reliability.

You will build and maintain strong working relationships with the development teams and the Zalando Data Foundation.

You will record and share information on current working methods and lessons learned to foster a high-performance data culture.


WE’D LOVE TO MEET YOU IF 
You have extensive experience with the Databricks ecosystem (Unity Catalog, Delta Live Tables, Workflows).

You have a deep understanding of the Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold) and Delta Lake internals.

You are proficient in Apache Spark (PySpark) and Python for large-scale data processing.

You have several years of experience in building and maintaining scalable Streaming & Batch pipelines, specifically using CDC (Change Data Capture) from RDBMS (e.g., MySQL/BinLogs).

You are familiar with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), Docker, Git (trunk-based development), and DevOps principles.

You bring the ability to translate complex business requirements into robust, de-normalized data models optimized for Lakehouse performance.

You have a good understanding of Cloud Infrastructure (AWS), REST APIs, and secure data exchange.

You possess excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and the ability to accurately document designs and processes.

Experience in aligning data strategies within a larger group ecosystem (like Zalando).


OUR OFFER
Tradebyte provides a range of benefits, here’s an overview of what you can expect. Ask your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about what we offer.

Employee shares program

40% off fashion and beauty products sold and shipped by Zalando, 30% off Lounge by Zalando, discounts from external partners

2 paid volunteering days a year

Hybrid working model - work where it works for you within Germany or the UK, with occasional office attendance required for moments that matter. 

Work from abroad for up to 30 working days a year

27 days of vacation a year to start for full-time employees

Relocation assistance available (subject to prior agreement)

Family services, including counseling and support

Health and wellbeing options (including Wellhub, formerly Gympass)

Mental health support and coaching available

Drive your development with our training offerings and biannual peer-to-peer review

The Leibniz Institute for the Analysis of Biodiversity Change (LIB) is one of the large, globally connected research museums of the Leibniz Association. In addition to excellent research on biodiversity and its change, we are advancing the further development of our extensive scientific collections with an international team and state-of-the-art technology. With our exhibition, knowledge transfer, and communication work at our exhibition venues Museum Koenig Bonn and Museum der Natur Hamburg, we want to spread enthusiasm for nature and contribute with our research topics to current socio-political discussions on species loss, climate change and the protection of ecosystems. The construction of an integrated natural history museum is being planned for the Hamburg location; the research infrastructure at the Bonn location is currently being significantly expanded.

Within the LIB, the Centre for Biodiversity Knowledge Science focuses on digital biodiversity research, with the ambition of establishing the LIB Open Knowledge Space as a globally open hub for scientific objects and knowledge, including all project- and collection-related data and knowledge from the LIB. Acting as a driver of digital innovation in biodiversity knowledge science, it will integrate expertise in semantic modelling, knowledge graphs, ontologies, artificial intelligence, citizen science, and knowledge transfer, serving as a bridge between collections, research, and society.

The Centre for Biodiversity Knowledge Science is looking to employ a

# Semantic Modeller / Knowledge Engineer (m/f/d), Hamburg

to work in our team as soon as possible. The successful candidate will be responsible for the formal semantic modelling of content in the LIB Open Knowledge Space. They will develop and maintain ontologies, graph schemata and their corresponding SHACL shapes using the BFO/OBO ecosystem and related tools, ensuring that biodiversity data and knowledge are represented in a precise, interoperable, and reusable way, compliant with the FAIR and CLEAR Principles.

We are offering a full-time (39.00 hours/week) or part-time position, located in Hamburg for initially 2 years with the possibility of a permanent contract. The remuneration is based on pay scale group E 13 according to German public salary (TV-L).

## Your tasks:

Lead development of formal semantic models, including designing, extending, and modularizing ontologies for biodiversity and collection data, in collaboration with the other LIB centres

- Create and curate knowledge-graph schemata (SHACL shapes) for the LIB Open Knowledge Space and ensure data quality through validation pipelines
- Implement and operate ontology-centric workflows
- Support open-source development and contribute to existing code bases
- Apply for third-party funding

## Your profile:

- Master’s    degree    (or    equivalent)    in    computer    science,    data    science, bioinformatics, or related field; PhD desirable
- Proven experience in formal semantic modelling and ontology engineering (OWL, RDF/RDFS, Description Logics, SPARQL)
- Familiarity with the Basic Formal Ontology and the OBO Foundry ontologies
- Experience in the development of ontologies and graph schemata using Protégé, ROBOT, the Ontology Development Kit (ODK), and LinkML
- Strong expertise in knowledge graphs and semantic technologies, including RDF, RDFS, OWL, SHACL, LinkML, SPARQL
- Good understanding of FAIR (meta)data Principles, FAIR Digital Objects, Linked Data, persistent identifiers, and semantic interoperability

## Desirable Qualifications:

- Background in research infrastructures or data-intensive scientific projects
- Publications or contributions to the OBO community
- Practical knowledge of biodiversity, life-sciences, or collection data.

Principal data strategists at Thoughtworks are experienced consultants who work with clients to create winning data solutions that meet business goals. Their responsibilities span in-depth reviews of current data and technology strategy, targeted data strategy, guiding clients to unlock the full potential of data, and providing high-level roadmaps.

This role entails a mix of advisory responsibilities in data strategy and governance, coupled with a solid delivery-lead role and a breadth of data and AI ecosystem expertise.

This is a client-facing, builder's leadership role. You will start with a small, senior team and grow it through technical depth, delivery excellence and thought leadership, rather than inheriting a large organisation to manage. The role is based in Germany and requires regular travel to client sites, up to approximately 50% of your time.

**Job responsibilities**

- You will collaborate closely with clients to understand their business ecosystem and goals, and co-create data and technology strategies aligned with their objectives.
- You will help define a clear vision for the client enterprise to become data-driven and aligned with the overall business strategy.
- You will consult on complex data programs, providing technical leadership and guidance as a data subject-matter expert.
- You will lead and interact with clients across various domains, addressing challenging problems, and collaborate with sales to turn them into viable solutions and winning proposals.
- You will act as a translator between business, data and IT, and communicate data strategy to senior client stakeholders, including C-level.
- You will own the creation of end-to-end viable data solutions, keeping in mind long-term impacts and overseeing program inceptions for new product development.
- You will be responsible for formulating data governance strategies addressing security, privacy and compliance requirements.
- You will enable capability building in data strategy and governance, growing the next generation of data strategists.
- You will create differentiated assets in data strategy and governance to take to market.
- You lead through influence rather than headcount: growing capability and raising delivery standards inside the organisation, while building our presence in the market through thought leadership, ecosystem initiatives and client-facing points of view.

**Job qualifications**

**Technical Skills**

- You have extensive experience as a consultant, with a proven track record of creating data strategy and solutions that drive business value.
- You have solid experience with data platforms and technologies, and can provide advisory and consultative guidance for clients and cross-delivery teams.
- You have experience engaging with C-level stakeholders to influence and enable the operationalization of an enterprise-wide data strategy.
- You have demonstrated leadership abilities, with the capacity to lead technical teams and drive projects to successful completion.
- You are flexible and adaptable across a variety of projects, leveraging technical expertise and leadership to maximise impact.
- You have a track record of ensuring proper data governance policies, including data lineage, quality checks and classification.
- You have experience with AI and ML use cases and landscapes and can influence the build of the right solutions to harness insights from data.
- You have experience building high-level solution frameworks, leveraging paradigms such as data-as-a-product and federated governance where needed.
- You have professional working proficiency in German (B2 minimum, C1 strongly preferred) and can build consensus with mostly technical stakeholders. Exceptional candidates with outstanding data and AI consulting credentials may be considered where German is not yet at this level.

**Consulting and commercial track record**

- You have worked in a consultancy or professional-services environment within the last five years, driving data and AI engagements end to end (recent examples matter more than historical ones).
- You can point to data and AI pursuits you helped win and shape within the last three to five years, including deals from around €3M upwards, and you can speak concretely to their commercial shape, trade-offs and delivery.
- You have grown a practice, capability or go-to-market asset, for example a reusable accelerator taken to market, combining solutioning, sales and delivery with tangible business outcomes.
- You stay conversant with the technology and hands-on enough in at least one relevant area to earn technical credibility with client and delivery teams, while leading primarily on strategy and advisory.
- You bring significant hands-on and leadership experience in data and AI (typically 10+ years) and, above all, the appetite to keep building: growing accounts, teams and capability rather than only overseeing them.

**Professional Skills**

- You understand the importance of stakeholder management and can easily liaise between clients and other key stakeholders, ensuring buy-in and gaining trust along the way.
- You are resilient in ambiguous situations and can adapt your role to approach challenges from multiple perspectives.
- You don't shy away from risks or conflicts, instead you take them on and skillfully manage them.
- You coach, mentor and motivate others and aspire to influence teammates to take positive action and accountability for their work.
- You enjoy influencing others and always advocate for technical excellence while being open to change when needed.
- Cultivating strong partnerships comes naturally to you; you understand how relationship building brings new opportunities to our business.
- You have professional working proficiency in German (B2 minimum, C1 strongly preferred) and can build consensus with mostly technical stakeholders. Exceptional candidates with outstanding data and AI consulting credentials may be considered where German is not yet at this level.

**Other things to know**

**Learning & Development**

There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. **Responsible Use of AI in Recruitment**

At Thoughtworks, we use AI tools to support our recruitment team with administrative tasks such as drafting communications, scheduling interviews and writing job descriptions.

Crucially, our AI tools do not screen, assess, rank or make hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by our team and all selection decisions are made exclusively by our interviewers and hiring managers.

We are committed to fairness and responsible AI. We actively manage our AI systems by testing, monitoring for biased outcomes and implementing mitigation measures. We hold our third-party vendors to these same high standards through a rigorous governance process. For additional information, please see our full Thoughtworks AI Policy for Recruitment.

stellenangebotsBeschreibung:
Apply Now  
(Senior) Data Engineer (f/m/d): RDF Knowledge Graphs and Generative AI

Date: 06/08/2026
Company: SAP


We help the world run better
At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.


What you`ll do
At SAP, we're integrating state-of-the-art AI technology with our industry-specific data and deep process knowledge to innovate across SAP products & services. Agentic AI based on Large Language Models (LLMs) is transforming how users interact with their business applications. Still, the understanding of structured and unstructured business data such as business data models, business process metadata and documentation is limited in pre-trained LLMs, challenging using agents at scale and for complex tasks. It is SAP's mission to overcome this challenge within the realm of Business AI. Our goal is to provide Knowledge Graphs (KGs) as key differentiators to address LLM challenges like hallucination and compliance, as well as enable the development of the foundation models on structured data to deliver distinctive generative AI solutions to our customers.


The Role
•    Unique opportunity to build the data foundation for SAP’s Knowledge Graphs – the source of explicit knowledge across multiple SAP domains.
•    Design and build robust data pipelines that ingest, transform, and load structured and unstructured business data (including SAP data) into RDF Knowledge Graphs at scale.
•    Map source data into ontologies and SHACL schemas, develop SPARQL-based transformations, and operate triple stores in production alongside Knowledge and Data engineering teams and stakeholders.
•    Collaborate closely with domain specialists and data owners to understand source systems (SAP and non-SAP) and translate their requirements into reliable Knowledge Graph data flows and provisioning.
•    Make critical design decisions on the data engineering stack – triple stores, ETL/ELT tooling, orchestration, and integration with downstream Generative AI applications.
•    Contribute to thought leadership at the intersection of Data Engineering, Knowledge Graphs, and Generative AI.
•    Present, discuss, and explain how high-quality Knowledge Graph data can benefit business use cases, and proactively propose new cases to relevant stakeholders.


What you bring
•    PhD or Master’s degree in computer science, artificial intelligence, physics, mathematics or other relevant disciplines.
•    2+ years of related professional experience with a strong background in Data Engineering, ideally including working with Knowledge Graphs in a business context.

NTT DATA is a trusted global innovator of business and technology services, helping clients innovate, optimize, and transform for success. **Overview:**

The Forward-Deployed Engineer is a client-facing builder within the AI GTM organization responsible for rapidly creating demos, prototypes, proofs of concept, and MVPs that make AI opportunities tangible for clients and account teams. This role combines hands-on engineering, AI fluency, product thinking, and field presence to translate client problems into working technical concepts using models, agents, data, workflows, integrations, and user experiences.#LI-AR2

stellenangebotsTitel: Data Engineer (m/w/d) für einen modernen, KI-gestützten Cloud-Data-Stack
stellenangebotsBeschreibung:
## Das wird dein Job...

- Gemeinsam mit deinem Team entwickelst du die nächste Generation unserer modernen Cloud-Datenplattform auf Basis eines Cloud-Native-Stacks weiter
- Du konzipierst und entwickelst Datenpipelines sowie Software zur automatisierten Verarbeitung und Aufbereitung von Daten aus unseren Fachanwendungen in einer Data-Agnostic-Processing-Architecture
- Du arbeitest in einem agilen Team und gestaltest unsere Datenstrategie aktiv mit – eigenverantwortlich, iterativ und im engen Austausch mit deinen Kolleg\*innen
- Du setzt KI-gestützte Tools wie LLMs, GitHub Copilot oder Claude Code selbstverständlich in deinem Arbeitsalltag ein und entwickelst gemeinsam mit deinem Team neue Einsatzmöglichkeiten für KI
- Du evaluierst kontinuierlich neue KI-Technologien – beispielsweise für Datenanalyse, Codegenerierung oder automatisierte Datenqualitätsprüfungen – und bringst diese in unsere Datenplattform ein
- Du arbeitest mit modernen Technologien wie Kafka, Kubernetes, Docker, Quarkus, Cube.js sowie weiteren State-of-the-Art-Tools
- Gemeinsam mit unseren Fach- und Domänenexpert\*innen übersetzt du fachliche Anforderungen in performante und skalierbare Datenlösungen
- Qualitätssicherung, Monitoring und DevOps gehören für dich selbstverständlich zur Entwicklung dazu
- Freitags nehmen wir uns bewusst Zeit für Innovation und Wissenstransfer – beispielsweise im Rahmen unserer Barcamps oder durch gemeinsame Experimente mit neuen Technologien
- Darüber hinaus kannst du dich – je nach Interesse – auch in übergreifenden Themen wie Security oder Qualitätssicherung einbringen

## Das wünschen wir uns...

- Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium mit IT-technischem oder mathematisch-naturwissenschaftlichem Schwerpunkt oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung
- Noch wichtiger ist uns deine Begeisterung dafür, komplexe Datenprobleme zu lösen und moderne Technologien einzusetzen
- Du hast bereits praktische Erfahrungen mit Cloud-Technologien sowie Kotlin/Java, SQL oder vergleichbaren Technologien gesammelt
- Idealerweise nutzt du bereits KI-Tools wie LLMs oder Copilots produktiv – oder möchtest dich intensiv in dieses Themenfeld einarbeiten
- Du hast Freude daran, Neues auszuprobieren, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und gemeinsam im Team Lösungen zu entwickeln
- Ein agiles Mindset sowie eine strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise zeichnen dich aus
- Du möchtest dich fachlich und persönlich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln

## So denkst du vielleicht...

Du passt zu uns, wenn die folgenden Sätze auch von dir stammen könnten:

- Ich möchte moderne Datenplattformen mitgestalten und nicht nur verwalten.
- KI ist für mich kein Hype, sondern ein Werkzeug, das meine tägliche Arbeit sinnvoll unterstützt.
- Ich habe Freude daran, neue Technologien auszuprobieren und Bestehendes kontinuierlich zu verbessern.
- Ich denke fachlich und technisch zusammen und finde gerne Lösungen für komplexe Herausforderungen.
- Ich arbeite eigenverantwortlich, schätze aber den Austausch mit meinem Team.

## Gute Gründe für Prosoz...

- Hohe Eigenverantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege
- Wertschätzendes und offenes Miteinander auf Augenhöhe und eine ausgeprägte Feedbackkultur
- Viel Raum zum Ausprobieren und für deine fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung
- Flexible Arbeitszeiten und -modelle, die voll auf deine Work Life Balance einzahlen
- Mobiles Arbeiten möglich
- Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag und mindestens 30 Tage Urlaub
- Attraktives Vergütungspaket und zahlreiche tolle Benefits
- Umfassendes strukturiertes Onboarding zum Orientieren, Ankommen und Netzwerken

stellenangebotsTitel: Mechanical Design Engineer, Sealing (m/w/d) Berlin Germany
stellenangebotsBeschreibung:
### What to Expect

As a Closures Sealing Engineer, you will work with some of the industry’s brightest minds and take engineering ownership of complete static and dynamic sealing systems as well as Daylight Opening trims for Tesla vehicles. Your work will focus on static and dynamic seals for current vehicle programs, with an emphasis on quality improvement, cost reduction, and manufacturing enhancements. Additionally, you will be responsible for the engineering and design of static and dynamic seals and DLO trims for future vehicle programs.   Your ownership of seals will include initiating and overseeing both virtual (CAE) and physical testing and analysis to validate new designs from concept to production. This role provides a great opportunity to interface with all aspects of vehicle development. You will work closely with the body, closures, electrical/firmware, exterior, and interior teams, as well as with manufacturing engineering, to establish world-class seal and trim designs along with world-class assembly processes.  

### What You’ll Do

* Serve as a member of the Vehicle Engineering Team, supporting closure system static and dynamic sealing and DLO trim development for Tesla vehicles  
* Fully specify elastomeric seal designs through the creation of specification drawings 
* Initiate seal CAE studies, interpret results, and iterate until geometry and materials meet design targets 
* Select appropriate materials for elastomeric static and dynamic seals and DLO trims 
* Understand manufacturing processes used to produce elastomeric seals, TP & metallic trims, and assembly processes 
* Achieve innovation-driven closure sealing & trims system targets for appearance, function, quality, cost, and weight 
* Establish system level architecture and functionality based on market research, design feasibility and prototyping. Creation of component specifications, and other technical design documents 
* Participate in the iterative process with the Tesla design and styling studio to deliver the optimal balance of form, function, and quality 
* Interpret/develop Tolerance Analysis, CAE, DFM, DFMEA, PFMEA simulations/results and integrate feedback into product designs 
* Manage and collaborate with key suppliers (both internal and external) to support overall vehicle development milestones and prototype/ production build events 

### What You’ll Bring

* Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent experience, with evidence of exceptional ability 
* Minimum of 3 years of experience in the design and engineering of static/dynamic seals and exterior trims 
* Strong understanding of GD&T 
* Ability to interpret FEA results and integrate recommendations into product designs 
* Experience designing new and improved seals and trim components using design software 
* Proficiency in CAD software V5/3DX for designing 2D sections and 3D geometry of seals. Experience designing complex seal molds is a plus 
* Proven track record of ownership of seal and trim designs from concept (new or improved) through production 
* Experience collaborating with supply chain partners in the development of new seals and trims 
* Must be proactive in improving processes and driving projects—examples of such initiatives should be provided 
* Excellent communication skills, resourcefulness, and time management Please apply with your CV in English.

stellenangebotsTitel: Mechanical Design Engineer, Glazing (m/w/d) Berlin, Germany
stellenangebotsBeschreibung:
### What to Expect

As a Closures Glazing Mechanical Design Engineer, you will work with some of the industry’s brightest minds and take engineering ownership of exterior glass systems and their integration into the closure architecture for Tesla vehicles. Your work will focus on the design and development of glazing systems for current vehicle programs, with an emphasis on quality improvement, cost reduction, and manufacturing enhancements. Additionally, you will be responsible for the engineering and design of glazing solutions for future vehicle programs.Your ownership of glazing systems will include initiating and overseeing both virtual (CAE) and physical testing and analysis to validate new designs from concept to production. This role provides a great opportunity to interface with all aspects of vehicle development. You will work closely with the body, closures, Autopilot, thermal, antenna, mechanisms, interiors, and sealing teams, as well as with manufacturing engineering, to establish world-class glass and trim designs along with world-class assembly processes.

### What You’ll Do

* Serve as a member of the Vehicle Engineering Team, supporting glazing and closure system development for Tesla vehicles
* Conceptualize, design, engineer, and launch components for glazing, seals, and trim products
* Collaborate with Autopilot, Thermal, Antenna, Mechanisms, Interiors, and Sealing teams to integrate and package components within each closure
* Fully specify glazing designs through the creation of specification drawings and 3D geometry
* Initiate CAE studies, interpret results, and iterate designs until performance targets are met
* Optimize glazing designs, including heater grids, coatings, and interlayers, to enhance system performance and minimize optical defects
* Understand manufacturing processes used to produce glazing components and drive design for high-volume production
* Achieve innovation-driven closure system targets for appearance, function, quality, cost, and weight
* Establish system-level architecture and functionality based on market research, design feasibility, and prototyping
* Participate in the iterative process with the Tesla Design and Styling Studio to deliver the optimal balance of form, function, and quality
* Interpret and apply DFM principles and integrate feedback into product designs
* Manage and collaborate with key suppliers (both internal and external) to support overall vehicle development milestones and prototype/production build events

### What You’ll Bring

* Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field, or equivalent experience showcasing excellence
* Passion for cutting-edge product design and innovation
* 3+ years of industry experience in consumer product design or a related field
* Proficiency in CAD software (CATIA V5/3DX) for creating complex 3D geometry and 2D drawings
* Knowledge of design for manufacturing principles across various commodities
* Strong understanding of engineering principles and mechanics of materials with creative problem-solving skills
* Experience with advanced manufacturing technologies, particularly related to glazing or ceramics, is preferred
* Ability to interpret CAE/NVH results and integrate recommendations into product designs
* Strong understanding of GD&T and tolerance analysis
* Proven track record of taking mechanical designs from concept through production
* Experience collaborating with supply chain partners on mechanism development
* Must be proactive in improving processes and driving projects—examples of such initiatives should be provided
* Excellent communication skills, resourcefulness, and time management

stellenangebotsTitel: Research Software Engineer (w/m/d) Leistungsoptimierung von HPC-Codes
stellenangebotsBeschreibung:
Das Deutsche Klimarechenzentrum (DKRZ) ist die zentrale Simulations- und Datenverarbeitungseinrichtung der deutschen Klima- und Erdsystemmodellierungsgemeinschaft und eine der führenden Einrichtungen auf diesem Gebiet weltweit. Das DKRZ betreibt nicht nur Supercomputer der höchsten Leistungsklasse und eines der größten Daten- und Archivsysteme, sondern beteiligt sich auch an zahlreichen nationalen und internationalen Projekten zur Verbesserung der Software und Infrastruktur für die Klimamodellierung. 

Hier bieten wir eine Stelle als

**Research Software Engineer (w/m/d)**

**Leistungsoptimierung von HPC-Codes**

**Ihre Aufgaben**

Das DKRZ spielt eine wichtige Rolle in einer Reihe von Projekten, deren Ziel es ist, die Erdsystemmodellierung (ESM) voranzutreiben. Dies trägt zur Weiterentwicklung des wissenschaftlichen Wissens in den Bereichen Erdsystemmodellierung und Klimaforschung bei. Im Zusammenhang mit der aktuellen Entwicklung digitaler Zwillinge der Erde ist es notwendig, immer komplexere Modelle und die dazugehörige Software an die leistungsstärksten HPC-Systeme in Europa anzupassen und sicherzustellen, dass diese Codes stabil und effizient laufen.

Als Teil des Teams von Research Software Engineers (RSEs) arbeiten Sie mit Erdsystemwissenschaftlern zusammen, um technische Herausforderungen im Bereich des Hochleistungsrechnens (HPC) und der Softwareentwicklung zu bewältigen. Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören die Weiterentwicklung, das Testen und die Optimierung bestehender gekoppelter Erdsystemmodelle. Dadurch können diese um neue Komponenten (z. B. Eisschildmodelle) erweitert werden, ohne dass die effiziente Ausführungszeit beeinträchtigt wird. Dies ist eine zentrale Herausforderung angesichts der Notwendigkeit, Ressourcen auf aktuellen und zukünftigen HPC-Systemen effektiv zu nutzen. Für diese Stelle suchen wir Kandidaten, die sich für die interdisziplinäre Umsetzung von Erdsystemmodellen interessieren und ihre Programmierkenntnisse auf neue Herausforderungen anwenden möchten.

**Ihr Profil**

•Hochschulabschluss in Informatik, angewandter Mathematik, Computerphysik/Ingenieurwesen oder verwandten Bereichen mit Schwerpunkt auf wissenschaftlichem Rechnen

•Starkes Interesse an und Erfahrung mit HPC-Systemen und paralleler Programmierung mit MPI/OpenMP

•Kenntnisse in der Programmierung mit C/C++ und/oder Fortran unter UNIX/LINUX und Skriptsprachen

•Erfahrung im Umgang mit und in der Programmierung von GPU-Systemen für wissenschaftliche Anwendungen ist von Vorteil

•Vorerfahrung in Algorithmen, Datenstrukturen und Design von wissenschaftlicher Software ist willkommen

•Sehr gute Kommunikations- und Englischkenntnisse

Wir bieten Ihnen die Arbeit in interdisziplinären Teams und eine hervorragende Anbindung an nationale und internationale Forschungsnetzwerke. Neben den spezifischen Umsetzungs- und Unterstützungsbedarfen unserer Projektpartner zeichnet sich Ihre Arbeit durch kreative Freiräume an der Schnittstelle zwischen angewandter Informatik und wissenschaftlicher Anwendungsentwicklung aus. Die Teilnahme an internationalen Konferenzen, Projekttreffen und Hackathons ermöglicht die Weiterbildung und Präsentation der eigenen Ergebnisse.

Unser Standort ist Hamburg, wir wollen aber durch flexible Arbeitszeit und -ort (bis zu 100% Homeoffice innerhalb Deutschlands) ein passendes Arbeitsumfeld schaffen. Die Vergütung erfolgt entsprechend der Qualifikation nach TVöD-Bund. Ihr Einstieg ist idealerweise im September 2026 möglich, der genaue Eintrittstermin kann individuell vereinbart werden. Die Stelle wird im Rahmen eines Drittmittelprojektes finanziert und ist zunächst bis Ende 2028 befristet.

Interessierte Bewerber werden gebeten, ein PDF-Dokument zusammenzustellen, das ein Anschreiben, einen ausführlichen Lebenslauf und etwaige zusätzliche Unterlagen (z. B. berufliche Referenzen) enthält. Bewerbungen müssen über das Portal https://dkrz.softgarden.io/de/vacancies eingereicht werden.

**Bewerbungsfrist: **Offen bis zur Besetzung. Bewerbungen, die bis zum 23. August 2026 eingehen, werden vorrangig berücksichtigt.

**Fragen? **Dr. Hendryk Bockelmann (bockelmann@dkrz.de) beantwortet sie gerne im Voraus.

stellenangebotsTitel: Senior Java Software Engineer - Data Platform (w/m/d)

Bechtle ist einer der führenden IT-Dienstleister in Europa. Wir gestalten zukunftsfähige IT-Architekturen - von klassischer IT-Infrastruktur über Digitalisierung, Multi Cloud, Modern Workplace und Security bis Künstliche Intelligenz und Managed Services.   *  Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören die Implementierung und Weiterentwicklung der Datenplattform sowie moderner APIs auf Basis von Java, PostgreSQL und Kubernetes - unterstützt durch innovative Tools wie Claude Code, wo sinnvoll.
  *  Außerdem wirkst du an der Definition und technischen Umsetzung von Datenqualitätsstandards, Data Contracts sowie Mandanten-, Rollen- und Rechtekonzepten auf Datenbankebene mit.
  *  In enger Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Fachrollen und dem Kunden sorgst du für eine erfolgreiche technische Umsetzung und Weiterentwicklung der Plattform.


Deine Skills? Mehr als interessant:

  *  Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Entwicklung mit Java sowie Frameworks wie Spring Boot oder Jakarta EE mit.
  *  Ein solides Verständnis von PostgreSQL zeichnet dich aus - von Schema-Design und Performanceoptimierung bis hin zu Row-Level Security und mandantenfähigen Datenbankarchitekturen.
  *  Zudem verfügst du über Erfahrung mit Cloud-native-Technologien, insbesondere im Umfeld von Kubernetes.
  *  Domain-Driven Design und API-First-Entwicklung sind für dich keine Fremdwörter und du bringst ein gutes Verständnis moderner Datenarchitekturen sowie deren Konzeption und Implementierung - auch in komplexen Projekten - mit.
  *  Du überzeugst durch starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und kannst technische Inhalte in Workshops sowie im Austausch mit Kunden und Stakeholdern klar und verständlich vermitteln.
  *  Außerdem bist du in der Lage, technische Entscheidungen nachvollziehbar zu begründen und strukturiert zu dokumentieren, beispielsweise mithilfe von ADRs.

At Tesla Engineering Germany in Freiburg, we’re building the future of sustainable energy by developing innovative power electronics for energy storage and vehicle charging systems. stellenangebotsBeschreibung:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

 

As a Data Governance Specialist with a focus on Data Governance Audit and Assurance, you are part of our growing Data Governance team within our Digital Core function, where we work together on supporting the wider needs and demands from the business, transforming the way we think of data and embedding data management in our key deliveries across all areas of the energy industry. In this fast-paced environment, you will assist your team in the formation and execution of the data governance framework, policy, standards; with particular focus on designing and implementing a modern data governance audit and assurance framework with controls, tools, enablers, and collaboration mechanisms to monitor and assess the data maturity of Siemens Energy domains and support continuous improvement. This role will also contribute to data governance enablement activities to make data accountability real; in this manner you will contribute to the execution of data governance framework, policy, standards. As a valued member of the Data Governance team, you will assist in the operationalisation of our enterprise data governance efforts to truly bring data governance alive at Siemens Energy.

 

 

How You’ll Make an Impact
     * Design and implement a modern data governance audit and assurance framework with controls, tools, enablers and collaboration mechanisms to monitor and assess the data maturity of Siemens Energy domains and support continuous improvement
     * Automate this framework making it user friendly so that it can be understood by our stakeholders and embraced into execution; leveraging our Data Governance tools, such as Data Catalog and Data Quality, and building upon our SE data governance processes  
     * Communicate data governance concepts effectively and facilitate training to enable and operationalize the data management roles in the organization 
     * Design, deliver and execute (baseline) data maturity assessments, along with other data governance controls or mechanisms, ensuring ongoing monitoring, alignment with targets (where applicable) and remediation actions  
     * Create and refine policies, procedures, and guidelines to mature the concept of data governance and the practices around data management across Siemens Energy; and align them where applicable to the audit and assurance framework. 
     * Engage with data stakeholders through the Data Governance forums and regular touch-points to formalize decisions and plans on data governance audit and assurance practices. including data maturity review cycles, gain their buy-in and follow-up on tracking and reporting of maturity improvements and targets
     * Support the development and maintenance of an end-to-end data lifecycle management approach; leverage the Data Management Enterprise Process and Data FAIR process and make sure our framework for data governance audit and assurance builds upon the enterprise data management practices 
     * Collaborate with the wider Data Governance team, Digital Core and the business; for the framework to be a successful collaboration endorsed and adopted by all; reinforcing the team efforts on establishing commons ways of working, adoption of the data governance metamodel, production of reusable governed data products and availability of AI-ready data

What You Bring
     * University degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Physics, Chemistry, Information Technologies or a related field. Experience with the Collibra Data Intelligence Platform, Informatica Data Catalog, Collibra Data Quality and Observability platform or similar products. 
     * Extensive proven experience in embedding Data Governance and Data Management in a large organization (preferably), particularly in designing, planning and executing audit and assurance controls in complex environments; therefore, guiding the business through the process, supporting them with recommendations and enabling them to act upon the findings. 
     * Specialist in designing and implementing Data Governance; has experience or very good understanding of Master and Reference Data Management, Data Quality Management, Metadata Management, Enterprise Data architecture and Data security practices. 
     * Proven facilitation skills to drive progress and resolve issues within large data governance programs, with expert understanding of existing data management frameworks, tools and best practices and ability to pragmatically apply these 
     * Strong communication and change management skills: able to explain technical concepts to business colleagues in plain language and naturally incorporate change management activities in the rollout of any data governance capability. Fluent in both written and spoken English 
     * Growth mindset: flexible to multiple, sometimes competing, demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity, and rapid change You are motivated to contribute to the transformation and decarbonization of energy generation globally

About the Team 

The Digital Core organization was created to streamline the lifecycle of software, data, cybersecurity, and artificial intelligence solutions for Siemens Energy.  Within Digital Core, our Data Governance team is a center of excellence that enables the organization to discover, access and use harmonized, high quality data in service of the Siemen’s Energy mission. We partner with the business to support them as they build strong foundations using policy, process and technology provided by our team. 

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.00 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

**Definition working student**

  
Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

  
This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

  
Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

  
**Your location**

  
Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

**Your tasks and responsibilities**

- Integration of new data sources into a Data Lake.

Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Datenwelt!

Data Engineering:

#### Job description

In order to support Aerodynamics, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

# **Senior Aerodynamics Engineer- Aerodynamic Data Modelling (d/f/m)**

Do you want to push boundaries at the heart of Airbus together with a team of great aerodynamic engineers? We want to pave the way into a more digital, sustainable and safer future. Come join us.

Aerodynamics is responsible for the aerodynamic design and characterization for all military aircraft programs along their product life cycle. Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

# **Your tasks and responsibilities**

**Your Mission:**

As senior aerodynamicist, you will own the aerodynamic modeling strategy for high agility fighter aircraft based. You will oversee the integration of wind tunnel, flight test and numerical simulation data and drive the development for future aerodynamic dataset modeling technologies.

**Your impact:**

As successful candidate you will

- **Lead the analysis and assessment** of aerodynamic characteristics for high-agility fighter aircraft.
- **Provide technical leadership and oversight** for wind tunnel and flight test campaigns.
- **Define the methodology and architecture** for modeling aerodynamic datasets throughout the envelope for stability & control, performance, and loads assessments.
- **Provide expert oversight** for flight test data analysis, helping to refine and perfect our aerodynamic databases.
- **Champion innovation** by driving the development of new technologies, such as data fusion and machine learning, to modernize our predictive capabilities.
- **Mentor junior and mid-level engineers**, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning.

- **Extensive professional experience (typically 7+ years)** in aerodynamics and flight mechanics, with a **proven track record** in fighter aircraft programs.

stellenangebotsTitel: Senior Data Science Research Engineer (m/f/d) – Instrument Analytics
stellenangebotsBeschreibung:
Work Schedule
Standard (Mon-Fri)


Environmental Conditions
Office


Job Description


Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. is the world leader in serving science, with annual revenue of approximately $40 billion. Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Whether our customers are accelerating life sciences research, solving complex analytical challenges, increasing productivity in their laboratories, improving patient health through diagnostics or the development and manufacture of life-changing therapies, we are here to support them. Our team  of more than 100,000 colleagues delivers an unrivaled combination of innovative technologies, purchasing convenience and pharmaceutical services through our industry-leading brands, including Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Fisher Scientific, Unity Lab Services, Patheon and PPD.


Location/Division Specific Information

We are a research, development, and production site in Bremen currently, with about 500 employees, whose “high-end” measurement and analysis instruments (mass spectrometers) are used in research and science worldwide. Our innovative products in the fields of Life Sciences MS and Inorganic MS, as well as T  Elemental Analysis, are among the leading products globally in their respective markets.


The Senior Data Science Research Engineer focuses on extracting scientific and product insights from large-scale instrument data to directly improve performance, calibration, and reliability of Thermo Fisher mass/optical spectrometry platforms. This role sits at the intersection of applied research, data science, and deep instrument knowledge, with a strong emphasis on focused, results-driven analysis rather than day-to-day feature development. This is an on-site position based in Bremen and requires regular hands-on access to spectrometers (including prototypes) and close collaboration with Production/Operations and Support during iterative validation, troubleshooting, and rollout preparation.


A day in the Life:


- Lead data-driven research initiatives using historical and live instrument data to improve calibration, stability, and performance.
- Apply classical statistics and machine learning / deep learning techniques to uncover non-obvious behaviors in complex hardware systems.
- Translate research findings into actionable improvements, including algorithms, procedures, and patentable innovations.
- Design, maintain, and leverage large-scale data pipelines (e.g., procdata-server–like systems) for scientific analysis.
- Collaborate closely with instrument physicists, firmware, and software teams while remaining primarily research-focused.
- Prototype and validate models and analysis tools in Python and related ecosystems, with pathways to production where appropriate.
- Contribute to intellectual property generation and technical strategy through exploratory but impact-oriented research.
- Work directly with spectrometers to extract insight from hardware data and domain knowledge and validate it with R&D and production
- Reproduce hardware behaviours, verify hardware configurations, and run controlled experiments to validate algorithm changes.
- Partner with Production Engineering, Operations, and Support to align on data capture, acceptance metrics, and rollout criteria; ensure metadata and traceability across instrument software, microservices, and test systems. Keys to Success:


Core Skills & Expertise


- Data Science & Machine Learning: statistical modeling, ML, deep learning, data manipulation, exploratory analysis.
- Programming: Python, C/C++, Rust, Java; strong systems programming background.
- Data & Infrastructure: SQL, NoSQL, Linux, Bash, DevOps, data pipeline architecture.
- Software Engineering: software design, testing, code review, test automation.
- Embedded & Instrument Systems: experience working close to hardware and embedded environments.
- Security & Reliability (secondary strength): cybersecurity, vulnerability assessment, penetration testing, network security.
- Instrument & production interaction: comfortable working hands-on with spectrometers and line-side test systems; understands acquisition workflows, sensor/telemetry signals, and data provenance.


Research & Impact Focus


- Proven ability to deliver high-impact insights when given protected time for deep analysis.
- Experience using historical instrument data to drive unexpected discoveries and measurable improvements.
- Demonstrated success in patentable innovation driven by data-centric research.
- Mindset & Working Style
- Strong preference for focused, uninterrupted research over fragmented feature work.
- Product-agnostic and impact-driven: prioritizes where data science can create the most value.
- Comfortable operating across domains, from low-level systems to advanced analytics.
- Motivated by real customer and product impact rather than tooling for its own sake.


Level & Background


- Senior-level engineer or researcher with extensive experience in software engineering and applied data science within complex technical systems.
- Prior experience at Thermo Fisher Scientific or equivalent industrial R&D environment strongly aligned.
- Scientific software engineer, research engineer, or applied computer scientist.
- Experience supporting data science or computational research teams.
- Familiarity with messy real-world scientific data is a strong plus.


What we offer:


- Employment with an innovative, future-oriented organization
- Outstanding career and development prospects
- Company pension scheme and other fringe benefits
- Exciting company culture which stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation
- IG-Metall; Tarif Unterweser, Entgeltgruppe 10


Join us in shaping the future of our industry and make a significant impact through your expertise and leadership by applying online with your CV and Motivation Letter including possible start date and salary expectations.


At Thermo Fisher Scientific, each one of our 100,000 extraordinary minds has a unique story to tell. Join us and contribute to our singular mission—enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer.

stellenangebotsTitel: Research Software Engineer (all genders) HPC Code Performance Optimisation
stellenangebotsBeschreibung:
The German Climate Computing Centre (DKRZ) is the central simulation and data processing facility for the German climate and Earth system modelling community and one of the leading institutions in this field worldwide. DKRZ not only operates supercomputers of the highest performance class and one of the largest data and archive systems, but also participates in many national and international projects aimed at improving the software and infrastructure for climate modelling. Here we are offering a position as

**Research Software Engineer (all genders)**

**HPC Code Performance Optimisation**

**Your tasks**

DKRZ plays a significant role in a number of projects with the aim of advancing Earth System Modelling (ESM). This facilitates the advancement of scientific knowledge in the fields of Earth system modelling and climate research. In the context of the current development of digital twins of the Earth, it is necessary to adapt increasingly complex models and corresponding software to the most powerful HPC systems in Europe and ensure that those codes run stable and efficiently.

As a member of the team of Research Software Engineers (RSEs), you will collaborate with Earth System scientists to overcome technical challenges in high-performance computing (HPC) and software development. Your responsibilities will include further developing, testing and optimising existing coupled Earth System models. This will allow them to be extended with new components (e.g. ice sheet models) without compromising the efficient execution time. This is a key challenge, given the need to use resources effectively on current and future HPC systems. For this position, we are looking for candidates who are interested in the interdisciplinary implementation of Earth System models and who want to apply their programming skills to new challenges.

**Qualifications / Experiences**

•Academic degree in computer science, applied mathematics, computational physics/engineering or related fields with a focus on scientific computing

•Strong interest in and experience with HPC-systems and parallel programming with MPI/OpenMP

•Knowledge of programming with C/C++ and/or Fortran under UNIX/LINUX and scripting languages

•Experience in the use and programming of GPU systems for scientific applications is an advantage

•Experience in algorithms, data structures and design of scientific software is welcome

•Very good communication skills and knowledge of English

**Employment conditions**

We offer opportunities to work in interdisciplinary teams and have excellent connections to national and international research networks. In addition to specific implementation and support requirements from our users and project partners, your work will be characterised by the freedom to work creatively at the interface between applied computer science and the development of scientific applications. Attendance at international conferences, project meetings and hackathons facilitate further training and the presentation of your own results.

Our company is headquartered in Hamburg, but we are committed to creating a flexible working environment. We offer a remote working option, with the possibility of working from home up to 100% within Germany. Remuneration will be based on the candidate's qualifications according to TVöD-Bund. The ideal commencement date would be September 2026, although this is flexible and can be discussed on an individual basis. The position is funded by a third-party project, with a limited initial timeframe until the end of 2028.

Interested applicants are requested to compile a single pdf document containing a cover letter, a detailed CV and any additional documents (e.g. professional references). Applications must be submitted via the portalhttps://dkrz.softgarden.io/en/vacancies 

**Application deadline:** Open until filled. Priority will be given to applications received by 23 August 2026

**Questions?** Dr. Hendryk Bockelmann (bockelmann@dkrz.de) will be happy to answer them in advance.

stellenangebotsTitel: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer, Interior Soft Trims (m/w/d) Berlin Germany
stellenangebotsBeschreibung:
### What to Expect

The Cabin Engineering team leads development and launch of nearly all customer-facing areas inside our vehicles including Seats, Instrument Panel, Door Trim, Console, Overhead Trims, Hard Trims, and Soft Trims for both cabin and cargo/trunk areas.  Our team’s goal is to innovate and engineer a premium Interior System for our vehicles while optimizing our critical attributes like cost, mass, manufacturability, etc. This is a pivotal role to act as liaison between US and Berlin engineering teams to tackle challenging problems together. As part of a global company, you will tackle engineering challenges together with US and CN Cabin teams alongside other cross-functional teams to continuously innovate and launch new products for Europe and other growing markets.  

### What You’ll Do

* Design development, validation and manufacturing launch of Soft Trim components (dependent on phase of ongoing program(s)) balancing inputs and attributes including, but not limited to, Design Studio styling, ergonomics, serviceability, integration packaging with cost, mass, craftsmanship, NVH, automation, etc. This iterative process includes close collaboration with Studio, Purchasing and Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and broader engineering teams through CAD development, CAE loops, RFQ stages, sourcing, part production, launch and build root-causing  
* Utilize and/or create DFSS, DFMEA, DVP&R concepts and processes to produce robust vehicle component designs alongside hands-on prototyping and trials to learn and fail fast. Consider both analytical and physical assessments including dimensional tolerance stack-ups in design as well as to create detailed GD&T drawings and corresponding checking fixtures. Work closely with Validation and Test & Reliability groups. Collaborate efficiently with key external suppliers and to support overall vehicle development milestones, prototype/production build events, and a successful start of production. Work in partnership with suppliers through part design (when applicable), root-cause troubleshooting, manufacturing trials, part and system level validation, etc. to actively understand and contribute to design solutions.  
* Analyze Field Reliability data of current programs to improve Interior Reliability through design/process/manufacturing changes. Release design changes through Tesla’s 3DExperience system to properly document and track part updates, MBOM changes, and PO releases to downstream teams and suppliers  

### What You’ll Bring

* Education background in Mechanical Engineering with a minimum of 3 years of experience in automotive Soft Trim interior component and subsystem engineering.  
* Proficient in English
* First principles, physics-based thinker, and problem solver attitude with mental agility to handle problems of varied scope and complexity, and tight timing constraints. Demonstrate engineering technical aptitude, excellent communication, and creativity
* Design and/or manufacturing experience with Soft Trim components such as carpets, floor mats, support foams and plastics, load floors, etc.  
* In-depth technical understanding of common automotive and new, latest mass manufacturing technologies and the relationship to design feasibility for a variety of processes including injection molding, thermoforming, vacuum forming, steam-chest molding, open-pour molding and lamination to achieve world-class craftsmanship/ performance targets  
* Proficiency in 3D modeling utilizing CATIA V5 or V6 is essential within an automotive product development environment. Experience with Change Control and Part Release within 3DExperience platform is a bonus
* Strong working knowledge of DFM and DFA, including familiarity with GD&T and dimensional controls  Please apply with your CV in English.

stellenangebotsTitel: Software Engineer (all genders) with a focus on development workflows
stellenangebotsBeschreibung:
The German Climate Computing Centre (DKRZ) is the central simulation and data processing facility for the German climate and Earth system modelling community and one of the leading institutions in this field worldwide. DKRZ not only operates supercomputers of the highest performance class and one of the largest data and archive systems, but also participates in many national and international projects aimed at improving the software and infrastructure for climate modelling. Here we are offering a position as

**Software Engineer **(all genders)**  
with a focus on development workflows**

**﻿**

**Your tasks**

DKRZ is heavily involved in the development of ICON and in its transition towards more open, collaborative, and transparent development workflows. In this context, you will help shape and improve the software development environment around ICON, with a focus on making day-to-day development, testing, review, and integration processes more efficient and accessible.

Your work will center on GitLab-based development workflows for ICON, including automation, CI/CD, merge request processes, and developer feedback mechanisms. You will explore and prototype practical ways to support ICON developers with AI-assisted tooling, for example for initial code reviews, CI feedback, test result interpretation, documentation support, or guidance during development.

A further focus will be the improvement of ICON’s CI infrastructure, including the use of Jacamar and container-based execution environments. You will contribute to more reproducible, maintainable, and user-friendly build and test workflows that support both established ICON developers and new contributors.

**﻿**

**Qualifications / Experiences**

* Academic degree in computer science, applied mathematics, computational physics/engineering, or a related field with a clear focus on scientific computing
* Interest in applying AI-assisted tools to software development, testing, review, and automation
* Experience with scientific software development, especially with code development workflows of shared open-source projects
* Experience with software development workflows in GitLab, including merge requests, code review, and CI/CD, ideally including designing these
* Practical knowledge of container-based development, build, and test environments
* Familiarity with CI runners, preferably including Jacamar or similar HPC-oriented runner setups
* Programming experience under Unix/Linux, including scripting languages such as Python or Bash, experience with HPC environments and programming is an advantage
* Motivation to support open, collaborative, and community-oriented software development
* Very good communication skills and knowledge of English

**Employment conditions**

We offer work in interdisciplinary teams and excellent connections to national and international research networks. In addition to specific implementation and support requirements from our users and project partners, your work will be characterised by the freedom to work creatively at the interface between applied computer science and the development of tools for scientific applications. Participation in international conferences, project meetings and hackathons enables further training and presentation of your own results wherever meaningful.

We are based in Hamburg, but want to create a suitable working environment by offering flexible working hours and location (up to 100% work from home within Germany). Remuneration will be based on the candidate's qualifications according to TVöD-Bund. You can ideally start already in July 2026, but the exact starting date can be agreed individually. The position is financed by third-party funded projects and is initially limited until March 2028.

Interested applicants are requested to compile a single pdf document containing a cover letter, a detailed CV and any additional documents (e.g. professional references). Applications must be submitted via the portal https://dkrz.softgarden.io/en/vacancies.

**﻿**

**Application deadline**: Open until filled. Priority will be given to applications received by 12 July 2026.

Questions? Dr. Jan Frederik Engels (engels@dkrz.de) and Dr. Hendryk Bockelmann (bockelmann@dkrz.de) will be happy to answer them in advance.

stellenangebotsBeschreibung:
## **Data Consultant to the Life Science industry - Frankfurt**

*Note: See further down for the English version.*

**Wir sind DAQUMA.**

Im Sommer 2022 gründeten Bjarke, Peter und Sille eine neue Beratung, die Life-Science-Unternehmen bei verschiedenen Aspekten der IT-Implementierung unterstützt. DAQUMA ist ein Anbieter von Technologie- und Datenlösungen, der Life-Science-Unternehmen durch Implementierungen, Datenintegration, Datenmanagement und Qualitätskontrolle zum Erfolg verhilft. Wir glauben an Flexibilität, flache Hierarchien und die Freiheit, sowohl DAQUMAs Reise als auch deinen eigenen beruflichen Weg aktiv mitzugestalten. 
 
Im Jahr 2025 haben wir unser Büro in Frankfurt am Main eröffnet. Jetzt suchen wir neue Kollegen, die sich diesem Abenteuer anschließen möchten.  Wenn du Lust hast, die Richtung des Unternehmens mitzubestimmen und sichtbar Einfluss darauf zu nehmen, wie wir exzellente Technologie- und Datenlösungen in Life-Science-Unternehmen bringen, freuen wir uns, dich kennenzulernen. 

**Über die Rolle**

Als Data Consultant unterstützt du die Life-Science- und Pharma-Kunden von DAQUMA bei datengetriebenen Initiativen.

*Du wirst:*

- **Beratung**: Du wirst Kunden beraten bei Themen wie Data Governance, Konfiguration und Analytics-Strategien, sowohl remote, als auch vor Ort beim Kunden. 
- **Implementierung**: Du wirst ETL-Pipelines und Cloud-Analytics-Lösungen entwickeln, um Datasets zu verarbeiten, zu analysieren und zu migrieren. 
- **Engineering**: Du entwickelst und optimierst unsere interne Software, einschließlich unserer Migrations-Engine. 
- **Innovation**: Du entwirfst zukunftsorientierte Data-Engineering- und KI-Lösungen, um unseren Kunden dabei zu helfen, Datenerkenntnisse in geschäftlichen Mehrwert umzuwandeln. 
- **Integration**: Daten über Enterprise systemen, wie Veeva, hinweg verbinden und harmonisieren. 

**Über dich **

*Du bringst mit:*

- Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung in der Beratung.
- Eine proaktive Denkweise und eine Leidenschaft für Problemlösungen und die Lieferung wirkungsvoller Lösungen.
- Programmierkenntnisse in Python (andere Sprachen sind von Vorteil).
- Vertrautheit mit Datenmodellierung, Data Warehousing und ETL-Frameworks.
- Erfahrung in der Life-Science-Branche ist von Vorteil. 
- Schulung in Veeva-Systemen und Kenntnis von Veeva ist ein grosser Vorteil. 
- Flüssige Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sind erforderlich. 

**Was wir bieten**

Bei DAQUMA macht unser Team den Unterschied. Wir schätzen jeden Berater/Beraterin und investieren in deine Entwicklung mit: 

- Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt und Vergütungspaket. 
- Einen engagierten Mentor, der deine berufliche Entwicklung unterstützt. 
- Spannende Projekte, die deine Erfahrung in der Life-Science- und Pharmaindustrie weiter ausbauen. 
- Kontinuierliches Lernen: Ein Umfeld, das laufende Weiterbildung fördert, mit Möglichkeiten, neue Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln, dein Wissen zu verbreitern und einem speziellen Budget für Weiterbildung. 
- Eine dynamische Scale-up-Arbeitskultur, in der du das Unternehmen aktiv mitgestalten kannst 

**Interessiert?**

Wenn du Teil dieses spannenden Vorhabens werden möchtest, sende deinen Lebenslauf an: [recruitment@daquma.com ](https://mailto:recruitment@daquma.com)oder über das Formular.

In the summer of 2022, Bjarke, Peter and Sille started a new consultancy supporting life science companies with various elements of IT implementation.
